theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (G : Euclid m → Euclid P) (x : Euclid m) (r : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → Set.InjOn G (Metric.closedBall x r) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x r, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G z)) → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m (G '' Metric.ball x r)
